claims.text: Rh-neg mother, Rh+ infant, ⍉sensitized: RhIG 300 mcg IM w.in 72 hrs of delivery
claims.quote: If women with Rh-negative blood have an infant with Rh-positive blood but are not sensitized, they should be given Rho(D) immune globulin 300 mcg IM within 72 hours of delivery to prevent alloimmunization.

claims.text: ⍉MMR immunity: vaccinate when preg = completed, b4 d/c
claims.quote: Pregnant patients who do not have evidence of immunity should be vaccinated when pregnancy is completed and before they are discharged from the health care facility.
claims.locator: MSD › Measles, Mumps, and Rubella (MMR) Vaccine
